CA-006_UnclearRolesAndResponsibilities.name: Unclear roles and responsibilities
CA-006_UnclearRolesAndResponsibilities.description: Lack of clarity regarding team roles, responsibilities, ownership, or decision-making authority.

COG-008_CompatibilityConstraints.name: Compatibility Constraints
COG-008_CompatibilityConstraints.description: Compatibility problems refer to difficulties, constraints, or potential inconsistencies that arise when software artifacts must remain compatible across versions, APIs, platforms, environments, or legacy behavior.

CR-001_LackOfTaskDiscussion.name: Lack of Task Discussion
CR-001_LackOfTaskDiscussion.description: Lack Of Task Discussion occurs when contributors begin planning or implementation activities without sufficiently discussing requirements, responsibilities, constraints, alternatives, or execution approaches before work starts.

CO-003_UnclearOrAmbiguousCommunication.name: Unclear or ambiguous communication
CO-003_UnclearOrAmbiguousCommunication.description: Unclear or Ambiguous Communication occurs when messages, explanations, requests, or instructions lack sufficient clarity, completeness, precision, or context, making them difficult to understand without additional clarification.

CA-011_RequestForTechnicalValidationSupp.name: Request for Technical Validation Support
CA-011_RequestForTechnicalValidationSupp.description: Request for Technical Validation Support occurs when progress depends on validation, confirmation, expert review, or approval from a maintainer, contributor, role, or external technical authority before work can continue.

COO-003_UnilateralTaskAssignment.name: Unilateral Task Assignment
COO-003_UnilateralTaskAssignment.description: Tasks are assigned or re-assigned without team consultation, leading to conflicts and decreased team motivation.

COO-005_LackOfCrossTeamMeetings.name: Lack of Cross Team Meetings
COO-005_LackOfCrossTeamMeetings.description: Failure to schedule regular cross-team meetings leads to poor alignment and breakdowns in the flow of crucial information.

COG-006_LackOfInterfaceClarification.name: Lack of Interface Clarification
COG-006_LackOfInterfaceClarification.description: Lack of Interface Clarification occurs when interactions, contracts, inputs, outputs, dependencies, or responsibilities between software components, services, APIs, or systems are not sufficiently specified, making integration or implementation decisions difficult.

COG-001_KnowledgeMonopoly.name: Knowledge Monopoly
COG-001_KnowledgeMonopoly.description: The concentration of critical technical or project knowledge in a single person or a small group increases dependency and the risk of project failure if they leave the team.

CA-013_InefficientOrInadequateTools.name: Inefficient or inadequate tools
CA-013_InefficientOrInadequateTools.description: Development activities are limited by insufficient tooling, CI limitations, or inadequate tool support.

COG-007_TechnicalComplexityDueToDependen.name: Technical complexity due to dependencies
COG-007_TechnicalComplexityDueToDependen.description: Technical Complexity Due to Dependencies occurs when dependencies among components, modules, services, tools, or external systems increase the effort required to coordinate, modify, validate, or implement software changes.

COL-003_InsufficientPeerSupport.name: Insufficient Peer Support
COL-003_InsufficientPeerSupport.description:
A contributor requests help, guidance, review,
or assistance but receives insufficient support from teammates.

COO-004_FrequentLeadershipConflicts.name: Frequent Leadership Conflicts
COO-004_FrequentLeadershipConflicts.description: Persistent disputes among those in leadership or key positions disrupt project planning and create friction within the team.

CL-001_LowSocialization.name: Low Socialization
CL-001_LowSocialization.description:
Team members rarely participate in discussions,
informal conversations, community activities,
or social interactions, resulting in weak social ties.

COO-001_CentralizedDecisionMaking.name: Centralized Decision Making
COO-001_CentralizedDecisionMaking.description: All major decisions are made by a small group of leaders, reducing team autonomy and limiting opportunities for distributed coordination.

CA-012_RepositoryAccessLimitation.name: Repository access limitation
CA-012_RepositoryAccessLimitation.description: Progress is limited by repository permissions, pull request access, CI access, or restricted validation access.

COG-009_LackOfTechnicalDocumentation.name: Lack of technical documentation
COG-009_LackOfTechnicalDocumentation.description: Lack of Technical Documentation occurs when architecture descriptions, component specifications, interface definitions, dependency information, configuration details, or technical design decisions are missing, incomplete, or outdated, making system understanding and implementation difficult.

CO-002_DelayedCommunication.name: Delayed Communication
CO-002_DelayedCommunication.description: Delayed Communication occurs when relevant information, responses, updates, or discussions are not exchanged within the time needed to support effective collaboration and decision-making.

COG-003_SoloDevelopmentPreference.name: Solo Development Preference
COG-003_SoloDevelopmentPreference.description: A team member's persistent preference for working alone impedes collaborative problem solving and reduces integration between team contributions.

CA-010_BlockageDueToTriageProcess.name: Blockage due to triage process
CA-010_BlockageDueToTriageProcess.description: Work is blocked because the triage process delays prioritization, assignment, review, or decision-making.

COO-006_MiscommunicationInTaskHandover.name: Miscommunication In Task Handover
COO-006_MiscommunicationInTaskHandover.description: Miscommunication In Task Handover occurs when work is formally transferred from one contributor, team, or responsible party to another, and critical information about task status, pending actions, responsibilities, deliverables, or expectations is not communicated correctly during the handover process itself.

COG-004_LackOfPeerAcknowledgement.name: Lack of Peer Acknowledgement
COG-004_LackOfPeerAcknowledgement.description: Contributions, ideas, efforts, or achievements are not recognized, credited, appreciated, or acknowledged by peers.

CA-009_ConstraintDueToTicketStatusForRev.name: Constraint due to ticket status for review
CA-009_ConstraintDueToTicketStatusForRev.description: Work progress is constrained because the ticket status requires review, validation, or state change before continuing.

CO-001_LanguageBarriers.name: Language Barriers
CO-001_LanguageBarriers.description: Language Barriers occurs when contributors experience communication difficulties due to differences in natural language, limited proficiency in the project's working language, translation problems, multilingual communication, or dialect differences that hinder mutual understanding.

COO-008_CoordinationMisalignmentForTechn.name: Coordination misalignment for technical validation
COO-008_CoordinationMisalignmentForTechn.description: Coordination Misalignment for Technical Validation occurs when team members are not aligned regarding who should perform technical validation, when validation should occur, what validation criteria should be applied, or how validation activities should be coordinated before approval or release.

COG-005_InformationDisconnect.name: Information Disconnect
COG-005_InformationDisconnect.description: Breaks in the chain of knowledge sharing or communication create misunderstandings, errors, and information gaps.

CA-004_NoKnowledgeTransferPolicy.name: No Knowledge Transfer Policy in Communication Activities
CA-004_NoKnowledgeTransferPolicy.description: The lack of a formal knowledge transfer policy results in critical information being lost during personnel transitions, reducing team efficiency and increasing dependency on specific individuals.

COL-004_LackOfCollaborationOrTeamwork.name: Lack of collaboration or teamwork
COL-004_LackOfCollaborationOrTeamwork.description: Lack of Collaboration or Teamwork occurs when contributors work independently and rarely engage in joint activities such as discussion, knowledge exchange, collective problem-solving, or shared decision-making, creating isolated work practices and collaboration silos.

COO-009_TaskReworkDueToMisalignment.name: Task rework due to misalignment
COO-009_TaskReworkDueToMisalignment.description: Task Rework Due To Misalignment occurs when contributors complete work based on inconsistent agreements, assumptions, requirements, or coordination decisions, causing previously completed work to be revised, repeated, reverted, or implemented again.

COL-006_LackOfTrustAmongTeamMembers.name: Lack of trust among team members
COL-006_LackOfTrustAmongTeamMembers.description:

ADM-003_LackOfStandardsOrBestPractices.name: Lack of standards or best practices

CA-007_InefficientOrganizationalProcesse.name: Inefficient organizational processes
